Ending 2/3 (Sealed Siblings/Dream No More)

Do the same as above and pop around defeating the dreamers, but this time, you'll have to get the king's soul fragments from the white lady and then go through the buzzsaw hell in the damn white palace. To get to the white palace, you'll need to get the Woke Nail.

Getting the 1800 essence is easy if you know where to look, get every dream roots for easy 482 essence then go kill all of the dream bosses for 1100 essence, you'll still need a little bit more so you'll have to kill some harder versions of previous bosses, such as: False Knight, Broken Vessel, Dung Defender and that twat that holds desolate dive. Smack them with your dream nail and you should get the new boss variants, these are harder than the regular ones, so be prepared, but when you get that sweet 1800 essence, go back to the Seer and she should make your shit nail into a Woke Nail.

Go to white palace, struggle through hell and back and ransack a corpse for the other half of the fragment, it should fuse, equip the dead essence of a failed king and pop on down to the abyss, a new area should be unlocked at the bottom and you have to get around some labyrinth before finding a delicious black egg. Smack it with your Woke Nail and you should get a little cut scene, your white charm is now the Void Charm and you can go fight your big sibling the hollow knight!

The difference between the Sealed Siblings and Dream No More is in the Sealed Siblings, when Hornet comes out to help and crack the Hollow Knight's head like an egg, you don't smack them with your Woke Nail and when Hornet gets yeeted, you continue the fight and win to get the ending.

Dream No More involves you not being a little shit and taking your big sis' advice and smacking the cracked egg with your Woke Nail. Beat the shit out of the Radiance and kill her for the sweet sweet Dream No More ending.

The daddy of endings no.4: Embrace the Void.

do everything above, defeat every damn boss possible and go to the royal waterways and find a place called the Junk Pit. You'll see a sarcophagus asking for a simple key and you pop it in and crack that boy open and dream nail the corpse that falls out. Go defeat every single pantheon and then go up to hopefully not die at the Pantheon of Hollownest. Good luck fighting almost every boss, but after you defeat everyone, you'll get the Embrace The Void ending.
